title: &6The Ashen Works
subtitle: Lightning in boxes, built by engineers who outlived their sun. Core Utilities.

quests.title: &6The Ashen Works
quests.subtitle: The Smith kept one book that isn't about swords.
description: &o"Before the Eclipse there were people who made fire you couldn't see. Lightning in a box, they called it. I called them show-offs. Then the sun went out, the boxes went cold, and I'm the last one left who can read their drawings."&r &7— the Smith Under Ash&r

The &6Ashen Works&r were the old world's engineering halls: generators, cables, crushers, a drill that reached the floor of the world. The Clockwork Path turns water into motion; the Works turn fire, lava and what light is left into &6Forge Energy&r (FE).
&7Craft the &6Core Utilities Manual&7 (a book and a copper ingot). It explains every block; JEI shows every machine recipe.

quests.title: Bones of a Machine
quests.subtitle: Iron outside, copper at the heart.
description: Every machine in the Works starts as a &6Basic Machine Frame&r (four iron and four &6Ashen Alloy&r around a pressed &6copper sheet&r make two) and thinks with a &6Basic Circuit&r (two copper, an iron and two redstone makes two).
&7Make two frames and two circuits. You will want many more.

&7The engineers built on what the Forge gave them: the alloy from your basin, the sheet from your press. The vaults return the favour: OmniVault's &6Logic Processor&7 thinks with one of these circuits.

quests.title: Read the Lightning
quests.subtitle: A key for every face, and a needle that counts.
description: The &6Configuration Wrench&r (two iron) rotates machines and turns cable and pipe faces on and off; Sneak + right-click takes any Works block apart without losing it. The &6Multimeter&r reads how much energy a block holds, or how many conduits a cable network has and how much it can carry.
Every machine's screen has a &6Sides&r panel: click a face to make it an input, an output, both or nothing. A comparator beside a machine reads its charge.
&7Make a wrench and a multimeter.

quests.title: &6Fire Into Lightning
quests.subtitle: Coal goes in. Something better comes out.
description: A &6Combustion Generator&r burns any furnace fuel for &640 FE/t&r: a lump of coal is 64,000 FE, a lava bucket 800,000 (the empty bucket stays in the slot). It only takes new fuel when its buffer has room, so nothing burns for nothing.
Generators push their power into anything touching them that takes it. Machines take it on every face.
&7Build a Combustion Generator: five iron, a furnace, a machine frame and two circuits.

quests.title: What Light Is Left
quests.subtitle: An eaten sun still leaks.
description: A &6Solar Panel&r drinks whatever grey daylight still reaches the ground: &620 FE/t&r on a clear day, half in rain, a quarter in a storm, nothing at night. It needs open sky above it and pushes its power down and sideways, so set a cable or a machine underneath.
&o"Funny thing to build under a black sun. The engineers built them anyway. Optimists, the lot of them."&r &7— the Smith Under Ash&r
&7Build a Solar Panel: amethyst, a comparator, a repeater, lapis and redstone around a frame.

quests.title: Gilded Panels
quests.subtitle: Four times the light from the same grey sky.
description: Wrap a Solar Panel in four gold ingots, three amethyst shards and a block of redstone: an &6Advanced Solar Panel&r makes &680 FE/t&r in full daylight.
&7Build an Advanced Solar Panel.

quests.title: Diamond Glass
quests.subtitle: The engineers' second-best idea.
description: Four diamonds, amethyst and a block of redstone around an Advanced panel make an &6Elite Solar Panel&r: &6320 FE/t&r. The Smith only drew this one out for you once you had cooled Moonsilver. He says diamonds are for people who know what they're worth.
&7Build an Elite Solar Panel.

quests.title: The Ultimate Panel
quests.subtitle: Four ingots of a dead king's metal, spent on daylight.
description: Four &5netherite ingots&r around an Elite panel: the &6Ultimate Solar Panel&r makes &61,280 FE/t&r, more than thirty combustion generators, and never asks for coal.
&o"Netherite on a roof. Morgrath would weep. Build two."&r &7— the Smith Under Ash&r
&7Build an Ultimate Solar Panel.

quests.title: Lava Never Sleeps
quests.subtitle: The world's own furnace, free of charge.
description: A &6Geothermal Generator&r makes &615 FE/t&r for every lava source block touching one of its faces, up to 90 FE/t with lava on all six. The lava is never used up. In the Ashlands a lava lake is a power plant Morgrath already paid for.
Its four &6obsidian&r want a diamond pickaxe, and in this pack a diamond pickaxe wants a Duskforged Ingot.
&7Build a Geothermal Generator: obsidian, glass, a bucket, a frame and two circuits.

quests.title: Copper Veins
quests.subtitle: Power that waits for you.
description: &6Basic Energy Cables&r (three copper and six blue dye make eight) carry up to &6512 FE/t&r per network and hold nothing themselves. Different tiers never connect. Wrench a face to cut a connection.
A &6Basic Energy Cell&r stores 1M FE and moves 2k FE/t: every face takes energy in, the front pushes it out. It keeps its charge when you break it, so the furnaces keep working through the night.
&7Run sixteen cables and build a Basic Energy Cell.
&7Build a second cell when you reach the sea. A Basic Energy Cell is the offering &6Kaelthar the Stormcaller&7 answers (Act III, &6The Drowned Sky&7).

quests.title: &6Ore Twice Over
quests.subtitle: Two dusts from every ore.
description: The &6Crusher&r (24 FE/t) turns an ore block into two dusts (copper ore into six) and raw ore into one dust with a 50% chance of a second. The &6Electric Furnace&r (16 FE/t) smelts any furnace recipe twice as fast as a furnace. Together they double what the mines give you.
The crusher grinds more than ore: coal into &6Coal Dust&r, cobblestone into gravel, gravel into sand, a bone into six bone meal, a blaze rod into four powder.
&7Build a Crusher and an Electric Furnace.

quests.title: The Alloy Smelter
quests.subtitle: Two things in, one better thing out.
description: The &6Alloy Smelter&r (32 FE/t) takes two inputs. An iron ingot and two Coal Dust make &6Steel&r. A gold ingot and four redstone make an &6Energized Ingot&r. An Energized Ingot and an ender pearl make &6Ender Alloy&r. Four netherite scrap and four gold make netherite, if you ever find the scrap.
&7Build an Alloy Smelter (iron, redstone, two blast furnaces, a frame and a circuit) and make four Steel Ingots.

quests.title: Pressed Thin
quests.subtitle: Steel skin for steel machines.
description: The &6Compressor&r (24 FE/t) presses ingots into plates: iron, copper, gold and steel. &6Steel Plates&r are the skin of every advanced machine. It also packs snow, ice and sand, and squeezes sixty-four Coal Dust into a diamond, which the engineers thought was very funny.
&7Build a Compressor, then press eight Steel Plates and two Gold Plates.

quests.title: The Advanced Frame
quests.subtitle: Steel outside, energized thoughts inside.
description: An &6Advanced Circuit&r is two basic circuits, two gold plates and an Energized Ingot. Seven steel plates and one of those around a basic frame make an &6Advanced Machine Frame&r: the body of the quarry and the grinder.

Both of those machines cut with diamond, a pickaxe in one and a sword in the other, and in this pack diamond tools take a &6Duskforged Ingot&r. The Works' advanced tier waits for the Ember Forge's second.
&7Make an Advanced Circuit and an Advanced Machine Frame.

quests.title: Heavier Lines
quests.subtitle: Eight million FE in one box.
description: &6Advanced Energy Cables&r (eight basic cables around an Energized Ingot) carry &64,096 FE/t&r. An &6Advanced Energy Cell&r (steel plates, an Advanced Circuit and redstone blocks around a basic cell) stores 8M FE and moves 16k FE/t.
&7Make eight Advanced Energy Cables and an Advanced Energy Cell.

quests.title: Ender Alloy
quests.subtitle: The drawings he kept back.
description: &o"Anyone who can't make the Forge's third alloy has no business holding sixty-four million of anything."&r &7— the Smith Under Ash&r

&6Ender Alloy&r comes out of the Alloy Smelter (an Energized Ingot and an ender pearl). Two &6Moonsilver Ingots&r, two Advanced Circuits and one Ender Alloy make an &6Elite Circuit&r, the brain of the Works' last tier.
&7Make four Ender Alloy Ingots and an Elite Circuit.

quests.title: &6The Drill to the Floor of the World
quests.subtitle: Nine by nine, all the way down.
description: The &6Quarry&r mines a 9x9 hole below itself, one layer at a time, down to bedrock: &6400 FE&r a block. It skips fluids, unbreakable blocks and anything holding an inventory, so the Deep's chests stay where they are. Give it an output face with a chest or a pipe, and turn on Auto-eject.
&o"The old crews ran these down past the Deep. Some of the crews came back."&r &7— the Smith Under Ash&r
&7Build a Quarry: steel plates, an Advanced Circuit, two pistons, an Advanced Machine Frame and a diamond pickaxe.

quests.title: Faster, Leaner, Wider
quests.subtitle: Eight upgrades a machine, no more.
description: Every machine has three upgrade slots that take up to eight upgrades in all.

&6Speed&r (steel, redstone, a circuit): +50% speed, at more FE per tick. &6Energy&r (steel, glowstone, a circuit): 15% less energy per tick, or 10% more output in a generator. &6Range&r (steel, ender pearls, an Advanced Circuit): 2 more blocks of radius for the Quarry, the Crop Harvester and the Mob Grinder. Enough of them and the quarry digs 33x33.
&7Make a Speed Upgrade and a Range Upgrade.

quests.title: Fields That Reap Themselves
quests.subtitle: The Garden grows it. The Works can do the stooping.
description: The Ash Garden's fields feed Last Light, and fields want stooping. The &6Crop Harvester&r watches a 9x9 patch on its own layer and the one above, cuts whatever is ripe and replants it from the drops: wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart, cocoa, sweet berries, melons, pumpkins, sugar cane and cactus. Bone meal in its slot feeds the young ones.
&7Build a Crop Harvester: an iron hoe, a water bucket, a frame and two circuits.

quests.title: Hands of Iron
quests.subtitle: Break, place, repeat. Nobody gets tired.
description: The &6Block Breaker&r breaks whatever appears in front of it the moment it appears: cobblestone generators and tree farms build themselves around one. The &6Block Placer&r places blocks from its inventory in front of it. Both follow their redstone mode, so a clock can pulse them.
&7Build a Block Breaker (an iron pickaxe) and a Block Placer (a dispenser).

quests.title: The Grinder
quests.subtitle: It never touches anything with a name.
description: The &6Mob Grinder&r strikes every mob in an area in front of it and gathers up their drops: &6200 FE&r a hit. Range upgrades widen the area, speed upgrades swing it faster.
It never touches players, named mobs or bosses. The worst things under the Eclipse are still your problem.
&7Build a Mob Grinder: steel plates, a diamond sword, two Advanced Circuits and an Advanced Machine Frame.

quests.title: Pipes in the Walls
quests.subtitle: Items that walk themselves.
description: &6Item Pipes&r (two iron and a glass make four) move items between inventories: chests, furnaces and other mods' machines alike. Wrench the face of a pipe that touches an inventory to make it &6extract&r (an orange arrow): it pulls items out every few ticks and shares them round-robin with every other inventory on the network. Wrench it again to turn the face off.
An Item Pipe moves 4 items every half second.
&7Lay sixteen Item Pipes.

quests.title: The Drill Feeds the Vault
quests.subtitle: Everything the drill brings up, filed away.
description: &6Rapid Item Pipes&r (eight pipes around an Energized Ingot) move 32 items every quarter second: enough to keep up with a quarry. Run them from the quarry into an OmniVault &6Network Port&r, which takes items for the whole network like one chest, and every block the drill brings up lands on the Vaults' storage cells instead of the floor.
&7Lay eight Rapid Item Pipes and feed your quarry into the network.

quests.title: Older Tricks
quests.subtitle: Before the Works made lightning, they made doors.
description: The Works' first blocks need no power at all. A &6Pushing Plate&r (a blank plate and an activator rail; redstone makes it stronger, four tiers) launches whoever steps on it the way it faces, unless they sneak. &6Effect plates&r (a golden apple, a redstone torch and one more thing) heal, hasten, poison or wither whoever touches them.

&6Filters&r only let one kind of thing through. A &6Player Filter&r lets Ashborn pass and stops everything else at Last Light's gate; the wrench inverts any filter. The &6Mob Net&r (string, an Eye of Ender and a stick) carries one mob wherever you want it, once you've been to the Ashlands for the blaze powder.
&7Make a Pushing Plate and a Player Filter.

quests.title: &6The Works Relit
quests.subtitle: Sixty-four million FE in one box.
description: Four Ender Alloy, an Elite Circuit and redstone blocks around an Advanced cell: the &6Elite Energy Cell&r holds 64M FE and moves 128k FE/t. &6Elite Energy Cables&r (eight advanced around an Ender Alloy) carry 32,768 FE/t. The Works are lit again, and they are yours.
&o"The engineers would have hated you. They hated anyone faster."&r &7— the Smith Under Ash&r
The manual's last page is a drawing nobody explained: a box falling out of the black sun, trailing fire. The Smith says the engineers were waiting for something to fall. Watch the night sky.
&7Build an Elite Energy Cell and eight Elite Energy Cables.
